paragraphs: R. Chiyya son of R. Yitzchak Atishaya, and R. Yaakov son of R. Bun: Jerusalem Talmud, Elu Megallechin, halakhah 1. R. Zeira taught him, and went up to visit him: Terumot, chapter 10, halakhah 10. R. Yirmeyah ruled for him: Jerusalem Nazir, beginning of chapter 3; Elu Megallechin, halakhah 5.
